body:
Instead of patching `build.gradle`, pass a parameter to the build command that specifies whether instant build is enabled. You can see an example in https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/4a44078451d746cee2c03af0677a31d97c8d3335/platform/android/export/export_plugin.cpp#L3570.

In [`config.gradle`](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/master/platform/android/java/app/config.gradle), add a new `isInstantApp()` method to read that parameter as done in https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/4a44078451d746cee2c03af0677a31d97c8d3335/platform/android/java/app/config.gradle#L362

You can then use the added method in [`app/build.gradle`](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/master/platform/android/java/app/build.gradle) to gate the addition of the instant dependency.

The `assetPacks` entry can also be updated to:
```
assetPacks = [isInstantApp() ? "" : ":assetPacks:installTime"]
```

> should i also make the verison configurable through config.gradle?

Yeah, it makes easier to manage versions that way.

had to do this because empty string in assetpacks like 
assetPacks = [""]
was giving build issues.


```gradle
assetPacks = isInstantApp() ? [] : [":assetPackInstallTime"]
```
thanks for the suggestion. due to extra commit being added, i have added this change to the main commit.
